description: Designs an electronic circuit from a plain description, such as an LED with its resistor, a 555 timer blinker, a transistor switch, a voltage divider, or an Arduino Uno or ESP32 breadboard project with its sketch. Use this when the person asks "how do I wire an LED to my Arduino?", "make me a circuit that blinks an LED", "design a 555 blinker" or wants a new project drawn up. The design passes breadboardhub's structural checks, with one corrected attempt if needed; it is not simulated. Returns the circuit as CircuitJS text, any Arduino code (with a link that runs an Uno sketch on a virtual board), the check result, a link that opens the circuit running live, and the parts list with DigiKey, Mouser and LCSC search links. Takes up to 2 minutes. Daily limit per account; an API token raises it.

description.description: What to design, in plain words, such as "a 9V battery lighting a red LED through a switch" or "an Arduino reading a potentiometer and dimming an LED" (10 to 1,000 characters).
